title: Lanternroot Walk
role: Walking the town at night: lanterns, townspeople, Hotaru beside you. Lively folk with a backbeat that never tires over a long walk, a fiddle tune you can hum, a whistle chorus, and one contrasting B section where the town slows and sighs before it dances again.
theme: The motif is the tune's opening: G D G B A G, in eighth notes on the fiddle in the verse. The whistle chorus climbs in dotted rhythms on the same G shape (G B D G); the bridge sighs down the motif's tail (B A G) in E minor colour; the outro lands on G.
reference: The player's request: the mode played music-rest, a lullaby in F at 76 BPM in 3/4, and wanted a solid soundtrack. This is the walking track: a pulse to walk to, a tune to hum, nothing that lulls.
form: silence 1, intro 4 (strummed guitar, drums enter, the whistle teases), verse 8 (fiddle tune opens on the motif), chorus 8 (whistle, dotted and lifted), bridge 8 (B section: a minor sigh, contrasting), verse 8 (return), chorus 8 (return), outro 4
style: lively lantern folk with a backbeat, fiddle melody, tin whistle, accordion, strummed acoustic guitar, upright bass, snare and bodhran drums, dancing and unhurried, bright intimate recording, instrumental, no vocals, G major, 110 BPM
